title: MapGIS 6.7 高程点、TIN、规则格网与等值线
execution: Use public stdio MCP tools for the documented backend subsets. Prior native GUI samples are reference evidence, not a requirement to drive foreground controls.
validation_scope: Native IDW/GRD; CDT2.0.1 with real MapGIS TIN storage/readback, constraints, editable WT/WL/WP and parent-loss recovery; ContourPy vectors; six GDAL derivatives with analytical/NoData/unit tests and actual native MSI/MPJ/output. Native TIN node/constraint/edge edits and saved-face sections passed actual public MCP, native save/reopen/output and parent-loss recovery for the documented dense full-hull profile. Original proprietary triangulator license connection is unavailable despite the existing DogServer67; Other models remain incomplete. Projected-metre DEM viewsheds now have analytic plane/ridge/range/unit tests, actual native MSI exact readback, portable MPJ/EPS/PDF/TIFF and exits116/117 recovery. NoData rejected because GDAL ignores it; full terrain family remains incomplete. D8PyFlwDir0.5.12 fill/direction/accumulation/basins plus nativeWT/WL/WP andsixMSIs,portableproject/outputs andreal118/119parentrecoveryverified. Othermodelsandparametersremainincomplete.
inputs: 明确水平/垂直坐标和单位，坡度及表面积要求 XYZ 同单位
数值高程和无效值定义，已知边界及独立检查点
网格间距、插值方法、等值层、基准高程和密度
输出为全新路径；同一输入失败后先核对，不重复盲算

steps.action: Bind saved WT and the exact finite height field. Inspect duplicate coordinates, bounds and units. Do not substitute screened background rows for raw interpolation inputs.

operation=native.tin creates a real .TIN through MapGIS native APIs after pinned CDT2.0.1 triangulation. Declare elevation unit, matching source CRS and optional breaklines by physical WT point IDs. Fresh native reader checks every vertex/face and constraints; native_tin_info computes unit-aware surface/cut/fill. prepare_tin_vectors exports the saved topology as editable WT/WL/WP, with original Z attributes. Existing operation=tin still produces a SciPy-derived WP with different semantics.
steps.limit: CDT is the public algorithm; this does not establish availability of the original proprietary MapGIS triangulator. Existing DogServer67 is running but the module reports server/license errors. Original binaries/license checks remain unchanged. 旧的快速生成25点样本曾提示内存不足并退出；该记录保留，不能据此判断整机内存不足。

steps.action: Edit bound native TIN into a new branch: node heights preserve XY/topology; XY moves, inserts/deletes and replaced breaklines use CDT retriangulation. Explicit convex unconstrained edge flip preserves XYZ/face slots. Retain metadata/node mapping, read every saved record and reconcile actual parent loss without replay.

Use saved native faces directly. Declare map-XY route/spacing, outside error or gap, and vertical exaggeration. CSV preserves source units/coordinates; editable WL/WT section geometry uses metres. Respect exchanged topology, include triangle crossings and do not infer geological strata.

Native GRD: choose operation=native.idw with explicit node-centre bounds, [columns,rows], integer power and anisotropy. All points are used without smoothing; search_radius/1e8 is a coincidence tolerance, not a cutoff radius. GDAL and another native PID compare every cell. The existing SciPy operation=grid produces WT nodes with different interpolation semantics.
checks: Valid range/mask and independent native/GDAL equality

steps.action: ContourPy directly creates WL contours or WP bands from the saved GRD. Set levels/colors and optional WT-hull/WP clipping explicitly, report empty levels, then native-save and reopen. Do not silently reinterpolate.

Run mapgis_prepare_grid_analysis on a saved native GRD. Declare vertical_unit; template CRS must match source metadata and have known linear XY units. Choose operation-specific options explicitly. GDAL3.10 algorithms require a complete 3x3 stencil by default; compute_edges permits neighbor interpolation, flat aspect remains undefined unless flat_as_zero. Analysis does not reinterpolate the grid.
checks: Analytical known plane and unit conversion
Finite NoData, masks, valid zero and TPI=-9999 retained
Convert TIFF to native MSI; check fresh native extent as well as pixels/masks
Save/reopen portable MPJ; render actual EPS/PDF/TIFF/JPEG

steps.action: Use mapgis_prepare_viewshed on a finite complete numeric DEM with square north-up cells in a projected metre CRS. Declare XY observer, vertical unit, observer/target height above DEM, distance in metres and curvature coefficient (0planar). Observer snaps to its containing cell centre. Output numeric0hidden/1visible/2outside and separate RGB-displayTIFF; exact distance mask corrects GDAL unfilled corners. Convert both numeric/display products to nativeMSI, check pixels/mask/extent then MPJ/EPS/PDF/TIFF. Do not infer buildings/vegetation or observed real visibility.
checks: Completed rawGDAL analysis adopted after realparentexit116; sealedbundleafter117; raw/source/workingSHA+mtime unchanged
NoData must be filled/cropped explicitly before analysis; at most2M workingcells

steps.action: mapgis_line_of_sight is read-only. Declare source hash/dependencies, matching projectedmetreCRS, observer/targetXY and elevationunit/heightsaboveDEM. Fixed MIT upstreamGDAL3.13 Pythonalgorithm, notinstalled3.10strict-equalitybug. Returns firstorderedblockingcell and mapWL/endpointsWT FeatureCollections. include_samples/include_profile explicitly return fullclearance table and localmetreprofileWL. Useprepare_creation/native resave/project/plot tosave/editactualMapGIS2D outputs. Do notmix mapXY and sectiondistance/elevation frames.

Existing SciPy piecewise-linear TIN analysis reports horizontal/surface area and separate cut/fill at an explicit base height. XYZ units must agree. The reference plane gives area10000, surface10246.95076596 and volume150000 above100; these are not general IDW values.

steps.action: Reopen saved products in fresh native processes. Reconcile completed IDW or native TIN saves after real parent loss without regenerating the completed product. Close owned contexts after validation.
